C0728.title: Computer Research and Development Reviews Backdoor Attacks and Defense Algorithms in Federated Learning
C0728.summary: A preprint article in Computer Research and Development notes that, in federated learning, the central server cannot directly observe how each client's parameters are updated. Malicious participants can train poisoned local models and upload their parameters, introducing backdoor behavior into the global model. Covering horizontal and vertical federated learning scenarios, the article surveys data poisoning, model poisoning, trigger injection, and related defense ideas such as robust aggregation and anomaly detection, comparing their advantages, limitations, and future challenges.

references.title: Survey of Backdoor Attack and Defense Algorithms Based on Federated Learning - Computer Research and Development
